device.modelDescription: Step module of the ch-packs family: assembles the CI failure triage result from its parts, with a one-sentence summary, in a fixed field order. A pure function of its input: no disk, no network, no state. It adds no receipt: the runtime does, from what it counted.

actionList.name: assemble
actionList.description: Takes the triage result's parts (the run, every failed job of the run, the error lines, the failure history or null, the owner hint or null, the coverage) and returns them as {summary, run, failed_jobs, errors, history, owner_hint, coverage}, in that order, each part's fields in a fixed order. Each failed job is listed with its failing step and first error line (the first 50; null when the caller gave none), and refused if any of them holds an e-mail address. With more than one, the summary starts "N jobs failed; the pack cannot tell which ones gate the run." Then one sentence: the failing step, the signature's verdict, how often it was seen in the window and the commit where it first appeared, e.g. "Step 'Run npm test' failed with a recurring signature seen 4 times in the last 50 runs, first at a1b2c3d." The coverage states what the history could not see: logs expired, logs truncated by the server, and logs unavailable by run and job; the summary ends "; 1 log expired, 2 truncated, 1 unavailable" when there were any, also when there is no history. Job names holding an e-mail address are refused, and at most 50 unavailable logs are listed.
